rule: Some ticket/handle patterns have situational value. They may overlay PAPER. They may never write Model_P.

allowed_patterns.when: ticket_pct >= 70 AND line moved the other way by >= 0.5 points
allowed_patterns.why: Classic reverse line movement. Public is on one side, the number moved opposite.
Fewer tickets, more dollars. Handle is not the same thing as ticket count.

allowed_patterns.when: Pinnacle led and the soft book stayed stale 30s and 180s
allowed_patterns.why: Already in NFL radar. Confirms whether an apparent edge was still there.

forbidden: create an official bet from splits alone
treat raw handle % as a probability
